contract.document_name.rationale: The title is PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT AND CO-BRANDING AGREEMENT; "SONGS 4 WORSHIP SERIES" is the product series subtitle.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement was entered into the 10th day of January 2000.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Section 8 says the agreement commences as of the date first above written, i.e. 10th day of January 2000.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Section 8: the term continues through December 31, 2004.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No automatic renewal, so no notice period to prevent renewal is stated.
